encoder.architecture: RR Conv1D + HRV MLP + 64-d fusion embedding

neural_process.type: contrastive gated residual temporal attentive neural process
neural_process.residual_direction: sign/strength constrained by query-specific time-aware cosine contrast: cos(q,A_stress)-cos(q,A_nonstress)
neural_process.residual_parameterization: query-contrastive bounded symmetric binary log-odds correction
neural_process.primary_target_prediction: Global Fusion anchor + gated query-contrastive temporal-attentive NP residual using deterministic prior mean
neural_process.source_model_selection_protocol: NP early stopping uses inner-train-only encoder/scaler; inner-val subjects are representation-unseen

adaptation_strength_calibration.aggregation: equal-weight hierarchy: episode -> subject within (context,class) -> context/class strata
adaptation_strength_calibration.tie_break: secondary proper score, then smaller gamma
adaptation_strength_calibration.activation_rule: activate raw source-selected gamma only when its balanced NLL improves on gamma=0 by at least the pre-specified minimum; otherwise use gamma=0
adaptation_strength_calibration.gamma0_contract: exact frozen Global Fusion probabilities without log/exp recalculation

query_protocol: same future query at all context sizes; most recent balanced nested target history; context strictly earlier than query
